s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of skin and muscle symptoms following immunotherapy
salient_findings: Prominent erythema at nailfolds with dilated capillary loops
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 50s
Diagnosed with stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma
Metastases in liver, lungs, and peritoneum
Developed skin symptoms within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab treatment
Received a second course of ipilimumab 14 months later
Experienced recurrence and worsening of symptoms
Physical findings include diffuse erythema and edema
Laboratory tests show elevated creatine kinase and C-reactive protein levels
Antinuclear antibody titer is 1:640 with speckled pattern
MRI shows mild short TI inversion recovery hyperintensity of bilateral vastus lateralis and rectus femoris muscles
Muscle biopsy shows atrophy of type II muscle fibers without evidence of inflammatory myositis

differentials: Neutrophilic dermatosis of the dorsal hands
per_call: Neutrophilic dermatosis of the dorsal hands

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient developed skin symptoms and muscle weakness after ipilimumab treatment, with elevated creatine kinase and C-reactive protein levels, and antinuclear antibody titer of 1:640 with speckled pattern

shortlist.label: Ipilimumab-induced myositis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient received ipilimumab treatment and developed muscle symptoms, with biopsy showing atrophy of type II muscle fibers

shortlist.label: Paraneoplastic dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has stage IV malignant melanoma and developed skin and muscle symptoms, with antinuclear antibody titer of 1:640 with speckled pattern

shortlist.label: Melanoma-associated dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has stage IV malignant melanoma and developed skin and muscle symptoms, with elevated creatine kinase and C-reactive protein levels

shortlist.label: Necrotizing autoimmune myopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Patient developed muscle weakness and elevated creatine kinase levels, with biopsy showing atrophy of type II muscle fibers

raw.rationale: The patient's skin symptoms and muscle weakness are consistent with dermatomyositis, and the presence of stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma suggests a paraneoplastic syndrome.

rejected.label: Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: Lacks consideration of the patient's underlying malignancy

rejected.label: Ipilimumab-induced myositis
rejected.why: While ipilimumab may have triggered symptoms, it does not fully explain the patient's condition

rejected.label: Melanoma-associated dermatomyositis
rejected.why: This is a less specific term that is encompassed by paraneoplastic dermatomyositis

rejected.label: Necrotizing autoimmune myopathy
rejected.why: Muscle biopsy did not show evidence of necrotizing autoimmune myopathy
